summary: NextTrip, Inc. filed an 8-K detailing a securities purchase agreement with an accredited investor for a Series B Convertible Preferred Stock offering. The company issued 408,421 Series B shares (including 40,000 as a fee) and a five-year warrant to purchase 100,000 common shares at $2.7550 per share, plus $0.125 over Nasdaq minimum price. The CEO pledged 1,365,314 shares as collateral under a limited-recourse guarantee. The purchaser gets a 20% participation right in future offerings and an exchange right. The company must file a resale registration statement within 15 days of closing. Watch for SEC review timing and potential dilutive impact from conversion or warrant exercise.
